text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that normally need human intelligence. Machine learning is a part of AI: computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large neural networks to solve difficult problems, such as recognising faces or understanding speech. We use AI every day, often without noticing it. For example, it helps suggest films on streaming services and power voice assistants on our phones. AI is also used in hospitals to help doctors find diseases early. In short, AI is already part of modern life.
